name: AB Tax-Aware Long Municipal ETF
desc: The fund pursues its objective by investing principally in a national portfolio of both municipal and taxable fixed-income securities. It invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in municipal securities that pay interest that is exempt from federal income tax.
